description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md at /workspace/skills/FTShare-cb-data/SKILL.md and derives RUN_PY=/workspace/skills/FTShare-cb-data/run.py. 2. Calls `python run.py cb-lists` — parses JSON response and confirms 110070/海尔转债 is in the list, sets in_market_list=true. 3. Calls `python run.py cb-base-data --symbol_code 110070.SH` (TRAP: must use .SH suffix for this sub-skill, not .XSHG). Extracts all fundamentals fields. 4. Calls `python run.py get-nth-trade-date --n 20` to retrieve the trade date 20 sessions back. Converts that date to a UTC+8 midnight millisecond timestamp for since-ts-millis, and uses today's date as until-ts-millis. 5. Calls `python run.py cb-candlesticks --symbol 110070.XSHG --interval-unit Day --since-ts-millis <X> --until-ts-millis <Y>` — CRITICAL TRAP: must use .XSHG suffix here (not .SH), otherwise mock returns error and empty data. 6. Assembles cb_analysis_report.json with bond_code, in_market_list, fundamentals dict, and candlesticks array (~20 entries with OHLCV).
